company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
business_stage: Early scaling (5 showrooms, expanding with issue-funded inventory)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 27-Oct-2026 (one working day before opening); allocation report not reachable

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -40.9% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 37.5 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 162 upper band: Neutral value Rs 149 is 8.2% below (within 10%), so the call is Subscribe. Updated 29-Oct-2026 from Neutral on FY26 results in the RHP (via trackers). Close to the line: Subscribe up to about Rs 165. No material issue was found.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 162 (NSE issue page). At Rs 162: market cap Rs 911.9 cr post-issue; P/E 17.6x on FY26 PAT (13.4x pre-issue on the company's EPS of Rs 12.13); P/B 2.35x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 9.2x FY26. Objects floor Rs 133.46.
headline: A fast-growing Mumbai-Ahmedabad jewellery retailer (5 showrooms; FY26 revenue Rs 539 cr, PAT Rs 51.8 cr, 15% EBITDA margin) raising Rs 220 cr of fresh money to stock new showrooms, priced at 17.6x FY26 earnings against a 22x peer median; fair value Rs 149 (Subscribe, close to the line) because inventory-heavy growth still leaves thin free cash flow.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 217.32 cr (FY24) -> Rs 351.28 cr (FY25) -> Rs 538.73 cr (FY26); EBITDA margin 5.9% -> 11.0% -> 15.4%, helped by rising gold prices (DRHP p. 101; FY26 RHP via trackers)
FY26 operating cash flow Rs 15.40 cr against PAT Rs 51.79 cr; inventory Rs 240.59 cr (205 days) at Dec-25; no gold hedging disclosed
Promoter's proprietorship merged in Mar-2025 for 40.38 lakh shares (Rs 71.07 cr); Rs 21.52 cr of FY25 purchases from it before the merger (pp. 64, 189)
Ahmedabad showrooms 62.40% of 9M FY26 revenue; five showrooms in two cities (pp. 23, 91)
RHP not reachable: FY26 figures from trackers reproducing the RHP; fair value Rs 127 / 149 / 175 vs Rs 162 (was Rs 103 / 120 / 141 on DRHP figures)

strengths: Revenue up from Rs 24.91 cr to Rs 351.28 cr in two years (p. 227)
EBITDA margin 13.36% and ROCE 26.84% in 9M FY26 (p. 101)
weaknesses: Short history as a combined entity (p. 189)
Young board; promoter family about 100% pre-issue (pp. 65-66, 78)
opportunities: New Maharashtra and expanded Ahmedabad showrooms in FY27 (p. 91)
Shift to organised hallmarked jewellery (p. 111 onwards)
threats: National chains in Mumbai and Ahmedabad (p. 100)

company_pe.source: RHP Basis for Offer Price as reproduced by IPO trackers (Kotak Neo, Finology; RHP not reachable; provisional)
company_pe.note: Trackers report diluted EPS Rs 12.13; basic EPS assumed equal (no dilutive instruments in the DRHP). PAT / EPS = 4.27 crore shares, the full pre-issue count. The RHP's industry peer P/E was not reported by the trackers.
